notes: Source names: the mixamorig: names this plugin's test fixture builds (scripts/__tests__/blender/fixtures.py: Hips, Spine, Spine2, Neck, Head, Left/Right Arm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot). The fixture was written for this plugin, not read from a Mixamo download, so every source name is unconfirmed against a real Mixamo FBX.
Unverified, in no source in this repo or in Blender: mixamorig:Spine1, Left/RightShoulder and Left/RightToeBase. A pair whose bone is missing is skipped and listed by retarget, not an error.
Unverified: Mixamo downloads are reported to use a numbered prefix (mixamorig1:) on some characters; such a rig matches no pair until its prefix is renamed or this map is copied with it.

Target names root, pelvis, spine_01, spine_02, spine_03, neck_01, head, clavicle, upperarm, lowerarm, hand, thigh, calf, foot, ball (_l/_r) are the UE list in this repo's plugins/blender/scripts/rig_check.py (its unreal naming profile; that file is derived from EL4CTEO/blender-skills). Not checked against an Epic skeleton asset.

Unverified, in no source in this repo or in Blender: spine_04, spine_05 and neck_02, the UE5 Manny/Quinn additions over that list. On a skeleton without spine_05 the Spine2 pair is skipped; for a three-bone UE4-style spine copy this map with Spine -> spine_01, Spine1 -> spine_02, Spine2 -> spine_03.
Spine: Spine -> spine_01, Spine1 -> spine_03, Spine2 -> spine_05; spine_02, spine_04 and neck_02 are unmapped and follow their parents.
root is unmapped: Mixamo has no root bone and its Hips carry the travel. For root motion run extract_root_motion(rig, action, 'pelvis', 'root'); for in place, make_in_place on pelvis.

roll_fix_deg and axis_fix are 0/null on every bone: retarget computes the rest-orientation offset between each pair itself. Write a bone as {"target": ..., "roll_fix_deg": 90} only when it twists wrong after retargeting.
